content.text:
- **Provider:** `CrustdataProviderOptions` has a new optional `search_sort: { field; order: "asc" | "desc" } | null`, default `null`. When it's `null`, `searchCompanies` leaves `sorts` out of the request body. When it's set, the body gets `sorts: [{ field, order }]`. A comment on the option records the finding that sorting by `basic_info.name` ascending returns the sparsest records first. Only `crustdata-provider.ts` and its test file changed. `scripts/crustdata-smoke.ts` wasn't needed.
- **Tests:** I added two tests. One checks the default body has no `sorts` key. The other checks an explicit `search_sort` appears in the body. I also removed the old `sorts` expectation from the "builds the filter body" test, since the sort is no longer hardcoded.
- **Checks:** `npx vitest run` passed (196 tests across 13 files). `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint` printed no errors. I ran no scripts and read no `.env`. The tests use a fake fetch, so there are no network calls.
